description: Small hand-labelled evaluation set for the Multimodal RAG Assistant. Each question lists the corpus files that contain the answer (source-level relevance) and key phrases a correct, grounded answer should contain. Questions with expected_no_evidence=true are out of scope for the corpus and test that the system reports insufficient evidence instead of guessing.

questions.question: What does a pooling layer do in a convolutional neural network?
Why do CNNs have fewer parameters than fully connected networks?
How are attention weights computed in self-attention?
Why do transformers need positional encodings?
How much training data was Whisper trained on and what audio window does it use?
What are common failure modes of Whisper?
When does the inner product in FAISS equal cosine similarity?
Does FAISS store document metadata such as page numbers?
Why does retrieval-augmented generation reduce hallucination?
What is the trade-off in choosing a chunk size for RAG?
What is the difference between a bi-encoder and a cross-encoder?
How does Qwen2-VL handle images of different sizes?
Which latency statistics should a deployed model log?
What is the boiling point of liquid nitrogen?
Who won the 2018 football World Cup?

audio_examples.reference_transcript: What does a pooling layer do in a convolutional neural network?
audio_examples.note: Record this sentence yourself and save it at data/eval/audio/pooling_question.wav; the evaluation skips audio examples whose file is missing. No spoken audio is shipped in the repository.
